environment.description: Same EKS cluster with Istio 1.20 service mesh. The worker-service pod runs in namespace 'processing' with sidecar injection enabled. An Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied to the 'processing' namespace with a DENY rule for requests where source.namespace is not in ['step-functions-proxy']. The Step Functions HTTP task integration routes through an envoy-based proxy pod in namespace 'orchestration' (NOT 'step-functions-proxy'). Additionally, a PeerAuthentication policy enforces STRICT mTLS on the 'processing' namespace. The AuthorizationPolicy uses a custom condition: when[{key: 'request.headers[x-sf-execution-context]', notValues: ['parallel-branch']}] with action ALLOW, meaning requests WITH the parallel-branch header are not covered by the ALLOW rule and fall through to the namespace-level DENY-all default. The Step Functions parallel branch tasks include this header automatically via the task definition's Headers field.
